description: Researched, license-documented sources used to constitute the SnapGlow style-classifier dataset (classes: code, ui, terminal, photo, diagram, text). Downloaded/synthesised images land in dataset/raw/<class>/ and are NEVER committed (see .gitignore). Targets follow tools/style-classifier/README.md: 500-2000 images per class before augmentation.

ui.rationale: Real application UI screenshots (web dashboards, settings, apps).

sources.notes: WebUI (CHI 2023). ~7k pages x several device screenshots. Filtered HF mirror. Use the *-default.png device renders for full-page desktop UI.
Optional mobile-UI complement. Enable with --include-optional; keep out of any commercial release model.

photo.rationale: Natural photographs (camera-roll style content shared into SnapGlow).

sources.license: Unsplash Dataset License (commercial + non-commercial; no redistribution of images)
sources.notes: ~25k curated photos. We use them only to train an on-device classifier, we do not redistribute the images.

text.rationale: Dense document pages (PDF readers, articles, docs).

sources.notes: DocLayNet (IBM). Document page images from finance/science/patents/law/manuals. Permissive commercial license - preferred over RVL-CDIP (research-only).

code.rationale: Rendered source-code screenshots. Synthesis guarantees clean licensing, balanced volume and IDE/theme diversity.

sources.license: generated by SnapGlow (clean) - rendered from permissively-licensed code
sources.notes: Pygments renders snippets across multiple themes/fonts. Source text: --code-source-dir (defaults to bundled snippets); optionally bigcode/the-stack-smol permissive slice.

terminal.rationale: Dark terminal / console / log screenshots. Synthesised with window chrome + monospace dark themes.

sources.notes: Renders shell sessions and log lines with terminal-style dark themes and a window title bar.

diagram.rationale: Flowcharts / graphs / node-edge diagrams. Synthesised via Graphviz for unlimited clean variety.

sources.notes: Graphviz renders random DAGs/flowcharts/ER-style graphs; matplotlib+networkx fallback if the dot binary is absent.
